quote: The parking of vehicles is prohibited or restricted in certain zones as set forth in this Section. The location of such zones shall be established by posting appropriate signage or other durable markings, by painting curbs or the edges of road surfaces in accordance with the colors listed below, or by a combination thereof: Yellow indicates a zone for: (1) Commercial vehicles to stop, stand or park for the purpose of loading or unloading freight in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign; and (2) Taxicabs to stop, stand, park for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign.

activation.condition: A motor vehicle stops, stands or parks in a source-established yellow zone.

obligation.description: For the assigned commercial-freight branch, retain commercial status, freight purpose and loading or unloading activity, zone, accompanying sign conditions and time for independent review. The taxicab passenger-use alternative is separate.

timing.description: Join original stop or stand interval and freight transfer to the sign-sourced local civil window.

parameter_refs.name: freight_action
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: requested loading, unloading or no transfer; observed action remains separately measured

parameter_refs.name: commercial_status
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed vehicle enterprise-use dossier; no marking-only inference

parameter_refs.name: posted_window
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: inside or outside the accompanying sign civil window, derived from sourced clock

parameter_refs.name: stop_zone
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: inside or outside the source-reviewed yellow curb zone, measured from full body footprint
